mapper.select: SELECT r.code, r.name, r.description, r.is_system AS isSystem, r.aliased_to AS aliasedTo, r.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(uc.cnt, 0) AS userCount, COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) AS permissionCount FROM roles r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_roles GROUP BY role_code ) uc ON uc.role_code = r.code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rp.role_code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM role_permissions rp GROUP BY rp.role_code ) pc ON pc.role_code = COALESCE(r.aliased_to, r.code) ORDER BY r.is_system DESC, r.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roles (code, name, description, is_system, aliased_to, created_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{isSystem}, #{aliasedTo}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE roles SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), description = COALESCE(#{description}, description) WHERE code = #{code}
